faq.q: How can I check my EPF balance and see the interest credit?
faq.a: You can check your EPF balance and passbook online via the EPFO Member e-Sewa portal (passbook.epfoindia.gov.in), through the UMANG app, by sending an SMS to 7738299899 from your registered mobile number, or by giving a missed call to 9966044425.

faq.q: What is the EPF interest rate for FY 2025-26?
faq.a: The Employees' Provident Fund interest rate for the financial year 2025-26 has been set at 8.25% per annum.

faq.q: Do I need to apply to get the interest credited?
faq.a: No, you do not need to apply. The EPFO automatically calculates and credits the interest to eligible member accounts once the rate is approved and notified by the government.

faq.q: What is a Universal Account Number (UAN)?
faq.a: A UAN is a unique 12-digit number issued by the EPFO to every EPF member. It acts as a permanent identifier, linking all your Provident Fund accounts from different employers under one number throughout your working life.

faq.q: What if my EPF interest is not reflecting in my passbook yet?
faq.a: If the interest is not immediately visible, it simply means the credit process is still underway for all member accounts. The EPFO updates these balances in phases. You can check again after some time.
